content: Ketexi Karaha kiekame kwinimieme katineuyutamiewekaitɨni, Karaha nu'aya meta 'ukaratsi tuminikɨ muyuwitɨnɨa nu'aya.

Karaha yuniwema kaniwarayexeiya yu'ɨyatsie, mɨkɨ kepauka memutiwawerixɨ Ketexi mekaniutaweiya. Mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: «'Ekɨ 'ahetsie pɨkatinake tita tapaapa mɨtatiku'eiririeni, xewitɨ pɨta mɨ'amaamakɨ».
Hikɨ Ketexi kaniuyuta'una 'iwamama mɨyame'utiyuaku, kaneyani Tuwi kwieyaritsie, mana hipatɨ mekanitinɨni 'axamete'u'iyaritɨ, mekaniku'uwakaitɨni 'axametekuyurietɨ.
'Arikeke kepauka 'amunitsixi 'ixaheritsixi memɨwarutakwi,
'ukirawetsixi Karaha kiekatari Ketexi mekanekuwitɨni Tuwi kwieyaritsie paitɨ.
Mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: ―Hikɨmɨ, pemanuyehaitɨani pepayani, 'amunitsixi temɨwatakwinikɨ.
Ketexi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Xeme xekateyɨa xemɨnetsi 'utixani'eri nepaapa kie xemɨnetsi'utawei. ¿Titayari hikɨ xenetekuwautɨwe, xeyumexɨitɨatɨ?
'Ukirawetsixi Karaha kiekatari mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: ―'Ayumieme hikɨ tematsikuwautɨwe. Kɨmɨ 'amunitsixi tepɨwaretakwini, meta Karaha kiekatari tiwa'aitɨwame pepayani.
Ketexi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Xɨka xenetsihewitɨni 'amunitsixi temɨwaretakwinikɨ xɨka Yawé netsiheyetuirieni, hikɨ yurikɨ xehetsiemieme ti'aitame nekanayeimɨkɨ.
'Ukirawetsixi yurikɨ mehaitɨkaitɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: ―Yawé tahetsiemieme pɨtimate: Yatepɨteyurieni kepemaineni 'ekɨ.
Ketexi kaneyani 'ukirawetsixi Karaha kiekatari wahamatɨa, teɨteri mekanenukakeni mɨtiwa'aitɨakakɨ. Mitsipa katiniutaxata naime Yawé hɨxie.
Hikɨ Ketexi tupiritsixi kaniwarenɨ'ani 'amunitsixi tiwa'aitɨwame wahetsɨa, memeita'iwawiyakɨ: ―Ketita perayexeiya nehetsɨa, titayari 'uperamie neteɨterima pewatakwinike.

'Amunitsixi tiwa'aitɨwame Ketexi tupiritsiximama mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: ―Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi memayekɨ 'Ekipitu, nekwie mepɨnetsi'unawairi 'Axinuni 'akiyari meta Kawuki 'akiyaritsie paitɨ ye'atɨkaime, meta Kurutani hatuxameyari paitɨ. Hikɨ keneneyetuiri 'aixɨa 'iyari.
Ketexi tawarita tupiritsixi kaniwarenɨ'ani, 'amunitsixi tiwa'aitɨwame hetsɨa,
mɨpaɨ tiwaruxatɨaka: «Ketexi mɨpaɨ kanaineni: “'Ixaheritsixi, 'amunitsixi wakwie mepɨkawarunawairi meta muhawitsixi.
Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi memayekɨ 'Ekipitu, makumawetsie mepuyekɨ Haramara Mɨxetatsie paitɨ mepu'axɨa, manata Karetsi paitɨ.

Hikɨ tupiritsixi mepɨwarenɨ'a 'Erumi ti'aitame hetsɨa, mɨpaɨ metewarahɨawetɨ: ‘Ketaneupitɨa 'akwietsie temuyekɨnekɨ’. Peru 'Erumi ti'aitame pɨkawarupitɨa. Yaxeikɨata Muhawi ti'aitame mekatenenɨ'airieni yaxeikɨa mehaitɨkaitɨ, mɨkɨta yapɨkatiutanaki'eri. 'Ana 'ixaheritsixi Karetsi mekaniuyuhayewa.

»”'Arikeke mekaniuhukaitɨni makumawetsie, 'Erumi kwieyari warita meta Muhawi, muhawitsixi wakwieyari 'aurie mekaniuyekɨne tau manatineika hepatsie, 'Axinuni hatɨayari manuyeka 'anataɨye mekaniyuhayewa. Peru muhawitsixi wakwietsie mepɨkaheutahaxɨa, 'Arinuni kwieyari manuye'atɨka mɨhɨkɨtɨkaikɨ.

»”Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi tupiritsixi mekaniwarenɨ'ani Tsikuni hetsɨa, 'amuxeutsixi tiwa'aitɨwame, Hetsiwuni mɨti'aitakai, mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: ‘Ketaneupitɨa 'akwietsie temuyekɨnekɨ takwietsie temeta'axɨanikɨ.’
Peru Tsikuni yuri pɨkatiwaruta'eriri, pɨkawarupitɨa kwieyatsie memuyekɨnekɨ 'ixaheritsixi, yukuyaxima pɨta kaniwarukuxeɨrieni Yahatsa mekanitiyaxe 'ixaheritsixi mekaniwarutakwini.
»”Yawé, 'ixaheritsixi wakakaɨyari, Tsikuni kaniyetuani meta kuyaximama 'ixaheritsixi memɨwara'iwakɨ. Mɨpaɨ tiuyɨku 'ixaheritsixi wakwie kanayani 'amuxeutsixi wakwie mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie memu'uwakai,
naime mekunatɨ 'Axinuni hatɨayari meta Kawuki hatɨayaritsie ye'atɨkaime, makumawe meta Kurutani hatuxameyaritsie ye'akame.
»”Yawé, 'ixaheritsixi wakakaɨyari, 'amuxeutsixi kaniwarunawairieni yuteɨterima mɨwayetuirienikɨ, ¿kamɨtsɨ 'ekɨta petatinawairieni?
¿Kamɨtsɨ 'ekɨ 'apiinite pekarayeitɨwa 'akakaɨyari Kemuxi mɨmetiyetuiriwa? Tameta yaxeikɨa tapiinite tepɨtehayeitɨwa Yawé takakaɨyari mɨtatiyetuiri.
¿Kamɨtsɨ 'ekɨ Tsipuxi nu'aya Waraki Muhawi ti'aitame reuyeta petiyɨweme peti'a'erie? Mɨkɨ hatsuaku pɨkatatsi'uyehekaxɨ pɨkatatsi'utakwi tame 'ixaheritsixi.

Haika tsienituyari wiyari kananuyemieniri 'ixaheritsixi Hetsiwuni meta 'Aruhexi wapiinite hamatɨa, naitɨ kiekari 'etsimɨyeyeu 'amɨyeyeu 'Axinuni tetsita mukumanekai. ¿Titayari 'anapaitɨ mɨpaɨ xekate'utiyua?
Ne 'axanepɨkamatitahɨawiwe. 'Ekɨ pɨta 'axapepɨtiyuriene nehamatɨa pepɨ'amiemɨkɨ. Yawé, mɨmariwe 'itsɨkame, yake'utayɨni ketemaku'ane 'ixaheritsixi meta 'amunitsixi”».
Matsi, 'amunitsixi tiwa'aitɨwame Ketexi tupiritsiximama pɨkawaru'eni.
Hikɨ Ketexi, Yawé 'iyari 'ipitɨaku, Karaha kaniuyeyani meta Manatsexi, Mitsipa kaniuyeyani Karaha, manari 'amunitsixi wahetsɨa kaniye'ani.
Ketexi Yawé yakatiniutahɨawe mariwemekɨ: «Xɨka yurikɨ penetsiyetuirieni 'amunitsixi,
kemɨ'ane meri mɨwayeyani nekiita netsihanakimieka, nehakunuayu 'amunitsixi newara'iwame, Yawé hetsɨa mieme kanayeimɨkɨ, hetsienamieme nekanitataiyamɨkɨ».
Ketexi hapa kananuyani 'amunitsixi watakwinike, Yawé kaniyetuirieni.
Xeitewiyari kiekari kaniuka'una, 'Aruhexi ye'atɨkaime Miniti paitɨ, 'Aweri-Keramini paitɨ. Waɨkawa mekateniuyurieni. 'Amunitsixi mɨpaɨ 'ixaheritsixi mekateniwaruta'aitɨani.
Kepauka Ketexi yukie munua Mitsipa, niweya kanayeyani 'enunakeke, tiuyuitɨaximetɨ tiuneiximetɨ. Ketexi niweya 'uka puyuxewikai meta 'ukitɨme yuniwe pɨkahexeiyakai.
Kepauka Ketexi mixei yukamixa kaneukatsana, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―'Ai, neniwe, yemekɨ 'aixɨa pepɨkanetsi'uyuri. 'Ekɨ peyɨyu 'aixɨa nepɨkayɨni. Ne Yawé yɨkɨ nepɨtiutahɨawixɨ, nemɨti'itani nepɨkayɨwe.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Nepaapa, Yawé kepemɨtiutahɨawixɨ kenaye'atɨa nehetsie, mɨkɨ pɨmatsi'uparewi 'amunitsixi pemɨwara'iwakɨ.
Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa nepɨmatitahɨawe, hatsuaku nepɨkatiwikieni, huta metseri keneneukwewi hɨritsie nemɨyemiekɨ muwa nemetitsuanikɨ 'ukari nemɨwanaki'erie wahamatɨa.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―'Aixɨa pɨ'ane kenemie. Nipitɨani mɨyemiekɨ huta metseri. Mɨkɨ 'ukari muwanaki'erie meyunaitɨ menekɨne hɨritsie, mana kaniutitsuani hatsuaku mɨkatiwikienikekaikɨ.
Huta metseri haye'aku yupaapa hetsɨa kaninuani, mɨkɨ yakatiniuyurieni kemutayɨkai. 'Uka pɨkatiwikiwekai. Mana mɨtiyehane 'ixaheritsixi me'iku'eriwatɨ mekanakɨne
mɨpaɨ meteyurietɨ, xeiwiyari 'anuyeyeikaku 'ukari 'ixaheritsixi nauka tukari hiwerika 'ixɨarariyari mekaniutiwewiwakaitɨni, kepauka mumɨ Ketexi niweya 'uka Karaha kiekame hetsiemieme.
